posthog-mcp-api.$comment: Identifies requests to the PostHog hosted MCP server (mcp.posthog.com, or mcp-eu.posthog.com for EU Cloud projects).

posthog-mcp-session.$comment: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify PostHog content.

posthog-mcp-read-all.$comment: Run any read-only PostHog MCP tool, i.e. the same set PostHog's own read-only mode exposes (SQL and analytics queries, insights, dashboards, feature flag and experiment lookups, error tracking, logs, replays, surveys, warehouse and workspace lookups), plus the MCP session handshake. Works in both the per-tool mode and the default CLI mode, where tools are invoked through the exec tool ("call <tool>") and discovered with its help, learn, tools, search, info and schema commands.

posthog-mcp-write-all.$comment: Run any PostHog MCP tool that creates, modifies, deletes or triggers something (feature flags, experiments, insights, dashboards, notebooks, cohorts, surveys, workflows, warehouse tables, project settings, ...), plus the MCP session handshake. Works in both the per-tool mode and the default CLI mode, where tools are invoked through the exec tool ("call <tool>"); the exec discovery commands (help, learn, tools, search, info, schema) that CLI-mode clients need to find tools are included as well.

posthog-mcp-read-workspace.$comment: View organization and project settings, members, roles, access control rules, billing and usage, integrations, reverse proxies, SSO configuration, approval requests, comments, support tickets and MCP connections, and discover what the PostHog MCP server can do: the CLI-mode exec commands (help, learn, tools, search, info, schema), the render-ui visualization tool, PostHog documentation search, app URL building, the MCP apps debug tool and sending product feedback (organizations-get, projects-get, org-members-list, billing-*, integration-get, docs-search, generate-app-url, agent-feedback, ...).

posthog-mcp-write-workspace.$comment: Change organization and project settings: create projects, switch the active organization or project, manage access control rules, roles, SSO, approvals, integrations, reverse proxies, comments and support tickets (switch-project, project-create, project-settings-update, access-control-*-execute, proxy-create, ...).

posthog-mcp-read-analytics.$comment: Run analytics queries and read their results, and view insights, dashboards and notebooks: HogQL/SQL (execute-sql), trends, funnels, retention, paths, lifecycle and stickiness queries, saved insights, web, marketing and metrics queries, heatmaps, AI citation tracking, dashboards and their tiles, subscriptions, alerts, annotations, notebooks, canvases and Streamlit apps (insight-query, query-*, insights-list, dashboard-get, alerts-list, notebooks-get, ...).

posthog-mcp-write-analytics.$comment: Create, update and delete saved insights, heatmaps, conversion goals, tracked AI prompts and web analytics rules, dashboards and their tiles, subscriptions, alerts and annotations, and create, edit, run and delete notebooks (including running their SQL and Python cells), canvases and Streamlit apps (insight-create, insight-delete, dashboard-create, dashboard-delete, alert-create, notebooks-create, notebooks-run, canvas-create, ...).

posthog-mcp-read-experimentation.$comment: View feature flags, their definitions, status and scheduled changes, early access features, experiments and their results, holdouts and shared metrics, and autoresearch pipelines (feature-flag-get-all, feature-flag-get-definition, early-access-feature-list, experiment-list, experiment-results-get, autoresearch-list, ...).

posthog-mcp-write-experimentation.$comment: Create, update, enable, disable, roll out, archive and delete feature flags, scheduled changes and early access features; create, launch, pause, end, ship and delete experiments, holdouts and shared metrics; and manage autoresearch pipelines (create-feature-flag, update-feature-flag, delete-feature-flag, feature-flag-roll-out-to-everyone, experiment-create, experiment-launch, experiment-ship-variant, experiment-delete, autoresearch-create, ...).

posthog-mcp-read-people-and-customers.$comment: Look up persons and their properties, view cohorts, and view customer analytics: accounts, contacts, deals, meetings, usage and health scores, feature requests, account notebooks and relationship definitions (persons-list, persons-retrieve, cohorts-list, accounts-list, accounts-retrieve, accounts-meetings-list, ...).

posthog-mcp-write-people-and-customers.$comment: Set or delete person properties, delete persons, create or update cohorts, and create, update and delete customer analytics accounts, contacts, custom properties, deals, feature requests, relationship definitions and account notebooks (persons-property-set, persons-bulk-delete, cohorts-create, accounts-create, accounts-destroy, accounts-custom-property-values-create, ...).

posthog-mcp-read-data.$comment: Explore the event schema (events, actions, event and person property definitions, data quality check results), the data warehouse (tables, saved queries, external data sources and their sync status, the data catalog, SQL variables and query endpoints) and data pipelines (CDP destinations, transformations and sources, their templates and invocation logs, and batch exports) (read-data-schema, actions-get-all, view-list, external-data-sources-list, endpoint-get, cdp-functions-list, batch-export-get, ...).

posthog-mcp-write-data.$comment: Create, update and delete actions, event and property definitions and data quality checks, and create, update, run, materialize and delete saved queries, warehouse tables, external data sources and schemas, data catalog entries and query endpoints (action-create, event-definition-create, data-quality-check-run, view-create, view-run, view-materialize, warehouse-tables-create, external-data-sources-*, endpoint-create, ...).

posthog-mcp-write-pipelines.$comment: Create, update, publish, test-invoke and delete data pipeline destinations, transformations and sources (Hog functions) and batch exports, which can send project data to external systems (cdp-functions-create, cdp-functions-publish, cdp-functions-delete, batch-export-create, batch-export-delete, ...).

posthog-mcp-read-monitoring.$comment: View monitoring data: error tracking issues, occurrences, stack traces and rules, logs and tracing spans and log alerts, session recordings, playlists and Replay Vision scanners, LLM analytics (generations, traces, costs, evaluations, datasets and managed prompts), and Signals inbox reports, scouts, anomaly scores and activity summaries (query-error-tracking-issues-list, query-logs, query-session-recordings-list, get-llm-total-costs-for-project, llma-*-list, inbox-reports-list, anomaly-search, ...).

posthog-mcp-write-monitoring.$comment: Change error tracking issue status and assignment, merge or split issues and manage error tracking rules, settings and alerts; create, update and delete log alerts; delete session recordings, manage playlists and Replay Vision scanners; create, update and delete LLM evaluations, clustering jobs, datasets and managed prompts; and act on Signals inbox reports and scouts (error-tracking-issues-partial-update, error-tracking-issues-merge-create, logs-alerts-create, session-recording-delete, vision-scanners-create, llma-evaluation-create, llma-prompt-create, inbox-report-actions-run, scout-run-now, ...).

posthog-mcp-read-messaging-and-surveys.$comment: View messaging workflows, broadcasts, email templates, message categories and opt-outs, and surveys and their responses and statistics (workflows-list, workflows-get, workflows-blast-radius, message-categories-list, opt-outs-list, surveys-get-all, survey-get, survey-stats, ...).

posthog-mcp-write-messaging-and-surveys.$comment: Create, update, test-run, enable, archive and convert messaging workflows and broadcasts, manage email templates and message categories, change the opt-out list, and create, update, launch, stop and delete surveys (workflows-create, workflows-update, broadcasts-create, opt-outs-add, survey-create, survey-launch, survey-stop, survey-delete, ...).

posthog-mcp-read-agents-and-engineering.$comment: View PostHog AI agent work and engineering tooling: agent tasks, channels and runs, the project knowledge used by agents (business knowledge libraries and documents, context wiki pages, skills and skill files, field notes, reminders and PostHog AI chat threads), AI code reviews (PostHog Review, Stamphog), visual review runs and CI/test analytics (tasks-list, channel-list, skill-list, context-wiki-page-retrieve, business-knowledge-documents-search, review-hog-reviews-list, engineering-analytics-flaky-tests, ...).

posthog-mcp-write-agents-and-engineering.$comment: Create and run agent tasks and channels, create, update and archive the project knowledge used by agents (business knowledge libraries, context wiki pages, skills and skill files, field notes and reminders), trigger code reviews and Stamphog digests, and change visual review settings and quarantines (tasks-create, tasks-run-create, channel-create, skill-create, context-wiki-page-update, reminder-create, review-hog-reviews-trigger, stamphog-review-runs-create, ...).
